name: Michelle Collins
bio: Michelle Danielle Collins (born 28 May 1960) is a British actress best known for her roles on television in the BBC soap opera EastEnders, as Cindy Beale, Coronation Street as Stella Price, and BBC dramas Sunburn and Two Thousand Acres of Sky. At one time, she was also a TV presenter on The Word. Description above from the Wikipedia article Michelle Collins, licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.
